conditions: Refine Rare and Uncommon relics to Radiant (100 Void Traces each); leave Blueprint relics Intact, since Radiant lowers their Common odds.

bonuses: Pick a teammate's identical reward at the reward screen; they get 5 bonus Void Traces.
